mapper.sql: sc.id, sc.code, sc.source_order_id, sc.source_order_no, sc.generate_batch_id, sc.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, sc.spec_code, sc.service_type, sc.duration_days, sc.code_silence_days, sc.expire_at, sc.status, sc.processing_type, sc.processing_request_id, sc.consume_type, sc.consumed_at, sc.version, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at, batch.batch_no, batch.display_name
FROM service_code sc LEFT JOIN service_code_generate_batch batch ON batch.id = sc.generate_batch_id LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = sc.owner_company_id

sql.if: AND ( sc.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sc.source_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR batch.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC, sc.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(sc.id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'PENDING' AND sc.expire_at > #{upcomingAt} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'PENDING' AND sc.expire_at > #{now} AND sc.expire_at <= #{upcomingAt} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'PENDING' AND sc.expire_at <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'CONSUMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consumed
